paper.title_en: Separable equations of motion for spinning test bodies in spacetimes with Killing--Yano symmetry
paper.abstract_en: At linear order in spin, the motion of a spinning compact body in curved spacetime is known to have two remarkable properties: (i) in Kerr spacetime, a suitable shift of the worldline maps the motion onto fiducial geodesics, yielding separable equations of motion; and (ii) in four-dimensional spacetimes admitting a non-degenerate Killing--Yano tensor, the dynamics are integrable. In this work, we generalize the worldline-shift method of (i) to the whole class of spacetimes in (ii), using a covariant construction built on the Killing--Yano symmetry. We show that spin then plays the role of charge: after the shift, the motion is described by a fictitious spinless particle, with charge set by the spin component along the orbital angular momentum, obeying a Lorentz-force equation. The effective field strength is built from the Ricci tensor and the dual of the Killing--Yano tensor. It vanishes in Ricci-flat spacetimes, recovering the geodesic description known in Kerr. In the general off-shell metric admitting a Killing--Yano tensor, we derive explicitly separated equations of motion, which reduce to quadratures and provide a constructive realization of the known integrability. Since no field equations are assumed, our results apply to any such spacetime, including those sourced by matter or arising in modified theories of gravity, and we illustrate them in Kerr--de Sitter spacetime.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将Kerr时空中自旋试验粒子世界线平移方法推广到所有具有非退化Killing-Yano张量的四维时空，给出显式分离的运动方程，且不假定场方程，因而适用于物质源时空及修改引力理论中的时空。选题具体、构造协变、结论具有可构造性，理论深度与方法清晰度较好；但属于既有可积性框架的推广，新颖性中等，且为刚提交论文，引用为零属中性。
decision.title_zh: 具有Killing–Yano对称性的时空中自旋试验粒子的可分离运动方程
decision.abstract_zh: 在自旋的一阶近似下，弯曲时空中自旋致密天体的运动已知具有两个显著性质：(i) 在Kerr时空中，适当地平移世界线可将运动映射到基准测地线，从而得到可分离的运动方程；(ii) 在允许非退化Killing–Yano张量的四维时空中，动力学是可积的。本文利用基于Killing–Yano对称性的协变构造，将(i)中的世界线平移方法推广到(ii)所涵盖的整个时空类别。我们表明，此时自旋扮演了电荷的角色：经过平移后，运动由一个虚构的无自旋粒子描述，其电荷由自旋沿轨道角动量的分量确定，并服从洛伦兹力方程。有效场强由Ricci张量与Killing–Yano张量的对偶构造而成。该场强在Ricci平坦时空中为零，从而恢复了Kerr中已知的测地线描述。在允许Killing–Yano张量的一般离壳度规中，我们显式导出了可分离的运动方程，这些方程化为求积，并给出了已知可积性的构造性实现。由于未假定任何场方程，我们的结果适用于任何此类时空，包括由物质源产生的时空或修改引力理论中出现的时空，并在Kerr–de Sitter时空中进行了示例说明。
